Families in Brighton looking for a reliable indoor play option often head to Hope Hive. A children's amusement and play centre in East Sussex, it offers a welcoming environment for children to explore, climb, and play. Highly rated.

Hope Hive has built up a track record locally, with 108 Google reviews from visiting families. The venue offers SEN-friendly sessions and a role-play area. 

Opening hours at Hope Hive can shift around school holidays and bank holidays, so it's worth a quick check before you set off.
